detail.longDescription: GTA 6 is here! I used to work in marketing automation, which mostly meant clicking around Klaviyo all day. So I built the obvious thing: an agent that does the clicking while I'm in Vice City. It runs in my Chrome through an extension (using Playwright), using the tools I am already logged into. It can build a welcome flow in Klaviyo click by click, the way I would at work. My favorite feature I added thus far? You can tell it to slow down and click more slowly :D Finishing a week of work by 10am is how you get caught. The serious part is how good models have become at using a browser. A few months ago I posted my Google Ads MCP here ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49548962 ). I spent the summer building 65 tools for one platform. Now an agent just uses the same UI I use, on almost any site. Great use of my summer :D It's slower than an API, but it doesn't need anyone to build the API first (and slow is a feature, see above). The plan has only one flaw: GTA 6 has no PC version, so the agent can't play it for me. Humans keep that one job. I think this could be a real business, but I haven't figured out exactly how. I made pages for the obvious use cases and started running Google Ads to see what people care about (although I might stop them soon as the prices are crazy, 10 USD per click is nuts): https://shoppilot.ch/email-marketing/ https://shoppilot.ch/google-ads/ https://shoppilot.ch/seo/ Happy to hear your thoughts on this :DD If I reply slowly, I'm playing GTA. If I reply instantly, it's the agent.
